date_semantics: The leading date is the first-creation date of the artifact line. Revisions keep that date and advance the version. Materially new snapshots or successor lines receive a new date.
time_semantics: HHMM is optional and uses local 24-hour time only for same-day collisions or multiple separately created outputs.
allowed_characters: ASCII letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore
legacy_policy: Files existing before activation are grandfathered and are not mass-renamed.

stable_aliases.reason: New sessions require one stable machine-readable checkpoint entry point.

new_alias_rule: Any additional undated stable path requires a new governed policy version with an explicit reason and alias type.
external_artifact_rule: Assistant-generated downloads and packages use the same dated naming scheme unless the user explicitly requests another name or a platform requires a fixed path.
